protocol_id_rule: sha256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON scientific_spec with sorted keys and compact separators

scientific_spec.scope: single-model fresh-corpus matched three-arm multi-seed Pythia-70M LoRA study
scientific_spec.study_question: On a fresh corpus, does periodic model-top-k unlikelihood retain its advantage over broad history unlikelihood and also avoid underperforming ordinary causal-LM fine-tuning?

implementation.required_source_state: objective execution must use a clean descendant of the objective commit containing only the prior bounded pilot evidence, this prespecification, and its frozen prompt set

corpus.name: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
corpus.freshness: not used by the tracked repetition-unlikelihood pilot specifications

training.seed_provenance: fresh prime seeds not used in the tracked repetition-unlikelihood benchmark specifications
training.single_factor_rule: The objective treatment is the only intended arm difference: no auxiliary objective, broad model-top-k history, or periodic-filtered model-top-k history.
training.no_retuning_rule: Do not change objective strength, proposal_top_k, context_window, candidate cap, seeds, prompt set, horizon, or acceptance thresholds after any study run begins.

generation_endpoint.prompt_provenance: fresh independent prompts fixed before training and not selected from corpus text or prior/current model outputs

decoding.seed: same seed as the training run

semantic_review.grouping: one group per seed and prompt with all three arm continuations
semantic_review.arm_labels: deterministically shuffled opaque labels using a pre-run key whose SHA-256 commitment is frozen below

rubric.preference: one opaque candidate label or tie

semantic_review.gate_role: review readiness is required for this run; completed human judgments are required before semantic-quality promotion but are not post-hoc substituted for the frozen token-loop gate

metrics.replication_effect: model_topk_periodic_minus_model_topk_history paired by seed, lower is better
metrics.absolute_control_effect: model_topk_periodic_minus_causal_lm_baseline paired by seed, lower is better
metrics.primary_aggregate: arithmetic mean of the three paired seed effects
metrics.safety_metric: eval_after_train.eval_loss paired by seed against causal_lm_baseline

acceptance.generation_evidence_validation: every report must round-trip through validate_zspace_generation_evidence in the Rust semantic core
identity_requirements: verified model runtime, execution, corpus materialization, tokenized dataset, training recipe, and finetune replay identities
one prompt_set_id across all nine generation reports
one decoding_config_id per seed shared by all three arms
content-addressed adapter identity for every generation report
stability_requirements: no non-finite before-train or after-train evaluation loss
no failed or partial optimizer trajectory receipt
no failed, empty, or malformed generation row
no early termination before 64 optimizer updates
objective receipts ready for all six objective-bearing runs
mechanism_requirements: the baseline recipe must be disabled and must not add auxiliary loss
periodic_candidate_count must be positive in every model_topk_periodic run
excluded_non_periodic_proposal_count must be positive in every model_topk_periodic run
periodic_candidate_count must be zero in every model_topk_history run
candidate_count must be positive in every model_topk_history run
acceptance.decision_rule: Pass only if all readiness, stability, identity, mechanism, replication, absolute-control, and CE-safety requirements hold. Record ready-but-negative if execution is ready but a frozen efficacy or safety gate fails; record blocked if a readiness or mechanism requirement fails.

interpretation.allowed_positive_claim: Within this prespecified bounded Pythia-70M/Alice replication, periodic filtering improved the selected loop metric relative to broad history and did not underperform ordinary fine-tuning, while preserving held-out CE.
interpretation.allowed_negative_claim: This frozen three-arm periodic recipe did not satisfy the prespecified bounded replication gate.
interpretation.promotion_if_passed: complete the blinded semantic review, then run a separately prespecified second-model study
